name: Volt Run
blurb: Grab the case, bank it on the pad, and don't get caught in the light. Sixty-second rounds that never stop.

landing.pitch: One case. Bank it. Don't get lit.
landing.about: A night alley, eight couriers, one case. Stand on the drop to score. Bump the carrier and it pops loose. The searchlight cooks whoever is holding it.
howToPlay: Grab the case. You are the only one who can score.
Stand on the DROP pad to bank points. The pad moves.
Bump the carrier and the case pops free.
The searchlight slows you and, if you stay, throws the case.

controls.phone: Drag to move. A second finger bumps.
controls.computer: WASD or arrows to move. Space bumps.
